findings.message: WriteSummary now returns nil when f.Write fails, silently discarding the error and leaving a truncated/corrupt summary file while reporting success to callers. This masks I/O failures (disk full, etc.) and can cause downstream consumers to trust an incomplete summary document.
findings.suggestion: Restore the wrapped error return: `return fmt.Errorf("write summary: %w", err)` (and consider removing or truncating the partial file on failure).
